marc:datafield.marc:subfield: "There are many different ways to find a job, yet all too often job seekers are passive and reactive, restricting their job search efforts to applying for advertised jobs. But if we take a proactive, creative approach to job search we will unearth a wide range of ideas and approaches that will broaden our job knowledge, networking opportunities and eventual success. This program offers lots of ideas and practical tips for taking a creative approach to your job search: from attending career expos and using the internet and e-networking, to tapping into your existing network of contacts and developing entirely new contacts."--Container.
